rows: Abstract class containing methods for performing input
Provides the capability to read from disk files
Adds buffering to an input stream for more efficient reading
Abstract class containing methods for performing output
Provides the capability to write to disk files
Adds buffering to an **output** stream for more efficient writing
Contains methods for output that never throw an exception (`System.out` is a `PrintStream`)
Abstract class for reading character streams; a subclass must implement `read(char[], int, int)` and `close()`
Reads text from a character-input stream, buffering characters for efficient reading of characters, arrays, and lines
Writes text to a character-output stream, buffering characters for efficient writing
Closes the output stream and releases associated system resources
Flushes the stream; any buffered bytes are written
Writes all bytes from the specified byte array
`void write(byte[] b, int off, int len)`
Writes bytes starting at offset `off` for a length of `len`
Closes the stream and any associated resources
Reads characters into part of an array
Skips the specified number of characters
Closes the stream, flushing it first
Writes a String from position `off` for length `len`
Writes a character array from position `off` for length `len`
